src='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    cnt = Counter(x for r in grid for x in r)
    fill = cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cands_r = [i for i in range(h) if all(grid[i][j] != fill for j in range(w))]
    cands_c = [j for j in range(w) if all(grid[i][j] != fill for i in range(h))]
    cc = Counter(grid[i][j] for i in cands_r for j in range(w)) + Counter(grid[i][j] for i in range(h) for j in cands_c)
    lc = cc.most_common(1)[0][0]
    R = [i for i in cands_r if any(grid[i][j] != lc for j in range(w))]
    C = [j for j in cands_c if any(grid[i][j] != lc for i in range(h))]
    out = [[fill] * (len(C) - 1) for _ in range(len(R) - 1)]
    for bi in range(len(R) - 1):
        for bj in range(len(C) - 1):
            corners = {grid[r][c] for r in (R[bi], R[bi + 1]) for c in (C[bj], C[bj + 1])}
            if len(corners) == 1:
                v = corners.pop()
                if v != fill:
                    out[bi][bj] = v
    while out and all(v == fill for v in out[-1]):
        out.pop()
    if out:
        while all(row[-1] == fill for row in out):
            for row in out:
                row.pop()
    return out
'''
